orbitos.name: ORBITA
orbitos.description: Official system assistant of the Orbita messenger
orbitos.welcome_msg_1:
Hello! My name is ORBITA.
Welcome to Orbita — a secure messenger with full end-to-end encryption.
orbitos.welcome_msg_2:
Important: make a profile backup in Settings. This way you can restore all your contacts and keys on a new device at any time.

Message history is stored strictly locally — this is our principle of protection from data interception.
orbitos.welcome_msg_3:
I recommend subscribing to the official channel to be the first to know about all updates:

Orbita Updates
ID: VZAXNAEWMWT3HGDZHI702JDB1PMSDCJ17DMUD2HIR9
orbitos.help_reply:
Available commands:

/start — restart the bot
/backup — backup and keys
/channels — official channels
/security — end-to-end encryption & security
/privacy — privacy and ID hiding
/calls — P2P audio and video calls
/appearance — themes and customization
/proxy — network proxy
/faq — frequently asked questions
/about — about Orbita messenger
orbitos.backup_reply:
To create a backup:

1. Open Settings
2. Go to the Backup section
3. Click Create Backup

Save the .orbita file and the 12-word recovery key in a safe place.
orbitos.channels_reply:
Official Orbita channels:

Orbita Updates — news and updates
ID: VZAXNAEWMWT3HGDZHI702JDB1PMSDCJ17DMUD2HIR9

Copy the ID and paste it into the search field in Join Channel.
orbitos.security_reply:
Orbita uses the Double Ratchet cryptographic protocol with X3DH, Curve25519, and AES-256-GCM.

Each message is encrypted with a unique ephemeral key. The server has no access to keys or message contents.
orbitos.privacy_reply:
In Orbita you can control your privacy:

• Hide ID: enable this in Settings → Privacy. Your ID will be hidden from other users.
• Local storage: messages are never stored on central servers.
• Screen protection: prevent screenshots inside the app.
orbitos.calls_reply:
Calls in Orbita use WebRTC P2P with direct end-to-end encryption (DTLS-SRTP).

For maximum privacy in Settings → Calls, you can enable 'Always relay calls' to prevent revealing your real IP address.
orbitos.appearance_reply:
You can customize the appearance:

• Dark, light or system theme
• Accent colors (purple, blue, emerald, amber, ruby)
• Custom chat wallpapers
• Font size and interface scaling
orbitos.proxy_reply: Orbita supports built-in proxies (SOCKS5 / HTTP) to bypass network restrictions and secure traffic. Available in Settings → Network & Proxy.
orbitos.faq_reply:
Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: Where are my messages stored?
A: Only locally on your computer.

Q: How to transfer data to another PC?
A: Create a .orbita backup in Settings and enter your 12-word key on the new device.

Q: What if I lose my 12-word key?
A: Without the file and key, recovery is impossible — encryption is mathematically irreversible.
orbitos.default_reply:
I understood you! If you have questions about Orbita, use one of the commands:

/help — list all commands
/backup — create backup
/security — security & encryption
/channels — channels
/faq — frequent questions

I can answer all your questions using Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI.

To connect, enter your free Gemini API key in Settings.
